component.name: gnote-calendar
component.summary: Lightweight Knowledge OS — Notes, Calendar, Tasks, Graph

description.p: Offline-first, lightweight Knowledge OS for Linux (C++17 + Qt6 PySide6, 1320×800). Daily journal auto-creates YYYY-MM-DD, networked notes with #tags and [[backlinks]], tasks with due:/prio:, calendar month + week (24×7), Pomodoro, folder sync to ~/Notas (one .md per note, Syncthing/Nextcloud/Git), force-directed graph, RFC5545 .ics for Gmail. Starts in <200ms, idles ~50MB (C++ Qt) / ~80MB (PySide6) / 12MB CLI. Fallback Tk.

Features v2.0.0: FTS5 search tag:/fecha:, highlight, templates, QGraphicsView graph filter, split markdown preview F9, QSystemTray 15min notifs, QSettings persistence, backup rotation, F11 maximize fix, a11y high-contrast.

Qt6 PySide6 v2.0.0: 4 sections 94px sidebar, month+week calendar, due/prio tasks, embedded graph, split markdown preview, QFileSystemWatcher, QSystemTray, backup rotation, a11y, F11 fix. Packaging .deb 700K portable 1.7M Flatpak 6.9.
